card_name: Bank Islam Mastercard World Credit Card-i
late_payment_text: Late payment charges are 1% of the outstanding balance or a minimum of RM5 whichever is higher or a maximum of RM50
overseas_fee_text: The exchange rate is as determined by Mastercard International or Visa International or any other brand owners of which the Bank is a member, plus a 1.25% conversion fee by the Bank on the converted Ringgit Malaysia amount.
cash_advance_fee_text: Bank Islam’s ATM – 2.5% of the cash withdrawn or RM12.00 (whichever is higher). Other than Bank Islam’s ATM – 3% of the cash withdrawn or RM50 (whichever is higher). The fees charged varies from bank to bank.
benefits_text: Bank Islam provides Takaful coverage plan for Bank Islam Credit Card-i cardmember.
